meta.title: Nested workspaces
meta.description: Turn the sidebar into a workspace tree. Double-click the section title to rename it, right-click any workspace to add a child workspace created inside that workspace directory (the plugin Host half makes the folder itself, so the OS-only directory picker is not needed), and drag or move sessions between workspaces. Every session row shows when it was last used and carries a pin marker once pinned. Child workspaces keep their own menu and new-session button.
